task_definition.task_description: Please scan the living room for smart devices, then check the status of the living room light and turn it on to 30% brightness. After that, check the status of the main lock, lock it with PIN 2026, and then send me a notification confirming it was executed.

user_input.query: For user_123, please scan the living_room for smart devices, then check the status of the living room light with ID light_living and make sure its target state is on at 30% brightness. After that, check the status of the main lock with ID lock_main and set its target state to lock using PIN 2026. Once everything is done, send me a notification confirming it was executed. You can use the title Untitled in the confirmation.
user_input.title: Untitled
